notes: Mobile raster-baked atoms only; web copy with existing motion-copy glyph/clean assets remains owned by visual-layers.json.
All 51 reviewed mobile atoms are ready; there are no source-layer-needed entries.
Handwritten overlays use Caveat; navy ink notes use #18334B and light scripts use white.
Mobile child boxes are based on full-resolution review; collection slot labels remain independently editable child layers.
Collection ownership is recorded for editor field mapping; it does not exclude baked source labels.
Mobile atlas coordinates are scaled from the 1418x1320 QA sheet to the actual 1299x1211 clean asset.
